notes.title: 🛠️ UPDATE 1.3.1.0 - SANDBOX STAGES
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we have some nice new features for Common’hood; New Stages for the Multiplayer and Sandbox modes of the game. Now you can finally play creative mode in any of the areas of the factory; West wing, Pumping Grounds, Machine Room, Factory Entrance, Green House, Barren Lands and the Shipyard. You can build creations in these locations with your friends in multiplayer. We have also continued fixing bugs based on the feedback we have received. See below the update notes, we hope you enjoy the update.

🌱- New Sandbox and Multiplayer stages
🌱- Hold to pack feature (pack any machine, blueprint, or custom object)
🌱- Quick swap between UI/inventory panels on the controller (d-pad)
🌱- Inventory overflow (receiving items with a full inventory) now spawns boxes with the items
🌱- Split the look sensitivity slider into X and Y components
🌱- Blueprint breakdown now works on the controller as well (hold X and then L trigger)

⚖️- Lost in-world key items now respawn if not detected in player inventories 
⚖️- Solar panels no longer depend on light levels. They now work like a consistent generator without the fuel costs


🐞- Fixed save panel input field not working
🐞- Crops now save their growth in other regions properly
🐞- Added additional safeguards for saving key items
🐞- Fixed settings dropdowns to display appropriate selections
🐞- The research panel now displays unlocked tech regardless of the tech level of the bench used
🐞- Blueprint aux panel steps list now scrolls on the controller

notes.title: 🛠️UPDATE 1.2.16.0 - Controller Support
notes.notes:
We are finally bringing all the recent console updates to Steam, including controller support and major improvements to gameplay, optimization, and many bug fixes. We are planning to continue developing updates based on the feedback we are getting on Discord. If you are not part of our discord community, you can join it with this link:
https://discord.gg/2rgYBADm5j


Here are the updates included in this patch:

🌱- Marketplace controller support overhaul:
	🌱--On tap left / right triggers add / subtract 1 respectively from quick buy total
	🌱--On hold left / right trigger, add / subtract 10 respectively every 1.2 seconds
	🌱--Hold A to buy / sell
	🌱--LB switches to buy tab (and moves cursor to buy window)
	🌱--RB switches to sell tab (and moves cursor to player inventory)
🌱- Added look sensitivity slider
🌱-New language support: Traditional Chinese
🌱-New lighting setup for Main Lobby

⚡- Icons now swap between controller and mouse even more effectively
⚡- Increased text size of hover tips
⚡- Performance improvements to the opening of inventory panels
⚡- Improvements to robot blueprint loading with controller

🐞- Fixed scrolling through blueprints on controller
🐞- Fixed an issue with the end of day sleep cutscene freezing
🐞- Fixed an issue causing the save/load panel to not display any previous saves
🐞- Removed an invisible concrete pile that was preventing building in certain parts of the Glass House
🐞- Removed ability to delete key items from inventory
🐞- Fixed hover text appearing when hovering mouse over change buy quantity arrows in market panel
🐞- Fixed minor backend bug when pressing bumpers in market panel
🐞- Machines now properly save/load if they are active and building
🐞- Fixed issue with accidentally being able to pick up machines that contained items
🐞- Fixed an issue where NPCs or robots completing an order could break your blueprints
🐞- Fixed certain hover tips overflowing the screen
🐞- Fixed create blueprint achievement from triggering to early
🐞- Fixed breakdown blueprint action on controller

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
After years of work, the time has come; Common’hood has a release date!

[previewyoutube=j8kIFsMWQNY;full]https://youtu.be/j8kIFsMWQNY[/previewyoutube]

Come November 10th, you’ll be able to dive into our community building and economy management game and get your hands on Common’hood’s unique set of customizable base building tools. 

Our story mode is complete, presenting with an emotional, challenging journey alongside Nikki to unravel the mystery of the abandoned factory. The full release will also come alongside a creative multiplayer mode for you to cooperatively build with your friends, come up with new designs and express yourselves freely.

We want to thank our community, as this has only been made possible through your support and assistance, from the simple act of wishlisting our game to those brave few who helped us test the game and deal with bugs, balancing and general feedback.

The Plethora Project team hopes you’ll love the game as much as we’ve loved making it. See you on November 10th on Steam!

Our Team is currently putting the finishing touches on the game, and through that we've been able to work on a soon to be released announcement trailer. This will not only show the advancement of the game since we last gave you a peek, but at the end of it you'll see our planned release date for this year! 

We want to thank all of you who have kept up with it, wishlisted us and even showed up on our Discord, and we hope you'll be pleased with Common'hood when you can finally play along.

-The Common'hood Dev Team

notes.title: New details about the upcoming multiplayer update!
notes.notes:
Hello Common’hood Community!

We know it’s been a while since our last update, but we want to assure everyone that development has been healthy and active. We would like to thank our testing team on Discord for working extremely hard to ensure all players have the best experience possible when playing Common’hood. We love seeing the thriving communities that those who have already jumped into the game have built. Those of you who are still waiting patiently, we can’t wait to see your amazing creations.

As you may have read, we have been able to upgrade our capabilities, allowing us to welcome a professional QA team to our workflow. Together, we have been able to work on and fix a ton of small polish issues with the game. Delivering the best version of Common’hood to players has always been our number one priority and we hope that everyone is impressed with these changes and updates.

We are excited about the upcoming multiplayer update and wanted to give players more of an idea of what they can expect when they head into the game with their friends later this year.  The first version of multiplayer that will be available to try will be an extension of our sandbox environment. It will give players the chance to build and design with their friends. No limit on materials gives players infinite possibilities. Once you’re done designing you can save your project and share it with either the Common’hood community online or in your single-player story mode.

We appreciate the support from all of those who have been keeping up with us in Discord, wishlisting the game, testing out the updates, and giving us valuable feedback. It is because of you that we are able to do this and bring Common’hood to life. Look out for even more updates coming soon!

notes.title: On our planned release date
notes.notes:
After months and months of development, beta testing and the demo release, we’ve been nothing short of thrilled by your enthusiastic response.  However, we’ve also realized that if we were to stick to our original release date of Fall 2021, Common’hood would not be the game we envision, and most importantly, the one you deserve.

Due to the mixture between simulation and narrative, we are not aiming to do an early access release, as we don’t want to spoil the story of the game as we gradually iterate over it’s implementation. We want to release a finished product.

At the current rate of development, the version of Common’hood that would come out on this date wouldn’t have the level of polish we find acceptable. This would leave us with the choice of either narrowing the scope of the final version or releasing a less optimized version of the game to patch and fix at a later date.

Therefore we are officially announcing that we’re aiming to have Common’hood out and in your hands on March 2022. We know waiting isn’t the greatest feeling, but we hope that the wait will be very much worth it. Common’hood has ended up being a much larger project than originally intended (which we are very excited about) and that has required a lot more balancing and polishing time.

We appreciate the support from all of those who have wishlisted the game, those who have kept up with  our progress and to the people in our Discord handing out valuable feedback and participating in our playtests. We hope you will stick with us til the end!

-The Common’hood Dev Team
